Hi Ethan — thanks for the detail and the attachments.

Sorry for the friction here. We've seen our anti-bot heuristics trigger on a small percentage of invites when clients come through corporate proxies or certain CDN routes. Quick guidance while we investigate:
- Please try the invite link from a network outside your corporate proxy (home/mobile) or ask Maria to try from a different network.
- Ask the user to clear cookies for supplier.redwood.com and then open the invite in a fresh private/incognito window.

I have looped in Ben and Kim to help with a manual activation if the link still fails. Ben/Kim — can we:
1) check the invite token (I saved it in the Atlassian ticket below) and attempt a one-time token reissue?
2) if the heuristic is firing, can we do a manual accept for Stella Holdings so PO visibility is enabled for mlopez@stellaholdings.com?

I filed a quick ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-9421. I'll add the screenshots and W-9 there. If security wants to see the request headers, Ethan included the UA and we can ask for the IP.

Thanks — I know timing is tight with their shipment.

— Lauren Bishop
